title: Lecturer on Law
bio: Sam Straus is an educator and facilitator who brings creative, relational, and systems-oriented pedagogies to his work. Sam serves as a Lecturer on Law at Harvard Law School where he teaches Advanced Negotiation: Fugitive Negotiation. He also serves as a Lecturer on Education at the Harvard Graduate School of Education where he teaches the Negotiation […]
